decision_question: How should the masked-expression probe be implemented and presented?
decision_options: A: Reword only - keep the MLM(-1) probe, name the synthetic-data cause and the convention, quote real-PBMC r~0.31 as a build-time number (labelled, not re-run), keep the 'embeddings + classification, not imputation' profile
B: A + add the upstream generative convention (needs flag_encoder from the original .bin as a 5th digest-pinned manifest entry), reported beside MLM
C: B + expose the GEP/MVC head (mvc_decoder from the .bin) as the masked-expression output
D: Drop the probe from the tutorial; keep the corrected account in the model card only
title: Masked-expression 'chance' result is mis-attributed to the shipped decoder; no pipeline bug - the synthetic cells drive it, and the checkpoint is a generative-pretrained model probed with the fine-tuning MLM convention
cells: 0 (intro 'pretrained with a masked-expression objective', objective 3), 23 ('training-time mask value (-1)'), 25, Interpretation; pipeline.py predict_masked/predict_masked_genes docstrings; MODEL_CARD.md decoder paragraphs
evidence_basis: CPU reproduction (torch 2.14.1+cpu, float32), same cells and masks: scripts/t80_1_repro.py -> work/t80_1_results.json; scripts/t80_1_lineage.py -> work/t80_1_lineage.json. Upstream checked at bowang-lab/scGPT cebd6fa: DataCollator mask_value=-1, tutorials mask_value=-1/pad_value=-2, n_bins=51, preprocess binning np.quantile(nonzero, linspace(0,1,n_bins-1)) - all match the pipeline; ContinuousValueEncoder (clamp 512, ReLU), ExprDecoder (3 linears, LeakyReLU), post-norm layer, mlm_output = decoder(...)['pred'] - match build_model; vocab: TDC vocab.json ids identical to upstream default_census_vocab.json for all 60,694 genes (+3 specials appended). Census pretraining script (4068d67 examples/pretrain.py): --training-tasks default 'both' -> USE_GENERATIVE_TRAINING; masked genes enter as gene emb + flag_encoder(1) with no value, attend to known genes + self; <cls> value = pad_value -2; loss on gen positions + MVC. TDC scgpt_gh_repo_original_model.bin carries flag_encoder, mvc_decoder (inner product), cls_decoder (177); its decoder and gene embedding are bit-equal to model.safetensors. Mean masked-bin Pearson, real pbmc3k 32 cells @15%: pipeline predict_masked 0.314 (independent re-implementation 0.314), generative convention 0.390 (cls 0) / 0.371 (cls -2), GEP/MVC head 0.551; @40%: 0.340 / 0.411 / 0.392 / 0.553. Synthetic sample cells (32): 0.087 / 0.081 / 0.065 / 0.151. Hosted run: 8 synthetic cells, 0.0045. expr_decoder predictions sit in bins ~26-33 under every convention (pbmc MAE 11.9 vs mean-bin 11.7). Lineage on real pbmc (12 T, 12 B cells, markers queried): MVC head T markers 35.2 in T vs 31.3 in B, B markers 37.3 in B vs 30.4 in T; generative expr_decoder +1.0/+1.2 bins; pipeline MLM +0.7/-0.2.
consequence: Cell 25 and objective 3 teach a wrong causal story. 'Chance' comes mostly from the code-generated cells (random background, no co-expression structure) scored on 8 cells, not from the decoder: on real PBMC cells the same pipeline call gives r~0.31, the checkpoint's own generative convention ~0.39, and its MVC head ~0.55 with clear lineage conditioning. 'The shipped decoder does not use lineage context' is true only of the expr_decoder under the off-convention MLM probe. 'Not a usable imputer' still holds for the expr_decoder (compressed band, MAE no better than the mean bin). Cell 23 calls -1 the 'training-time' mask value; it is upstream's fine-tuning MLM convention, not this checkpoint's pretraining convention.
recommended_correction: No code fix: MASK_VALUE, pad handling, binning, vocab, <cls>, output key and dtype are all correct against upstream. Reword cells 0/23/25, objective 3 and MODEL_CARD: -1 is upstream's fine-tuning MLM convention; whole-human was pretrained generatively (masked genes enter without a value, plus a flag embedding and an MVC head, both dropped from the TDC safetensors); on the synthetic cells every convention is near chance because the cells carry no co-expression; on real PBMC the probe gives r~0.31 (MLM) / ~0.39 (generative) with predictions compressed into bins ~26-33, so it is not an imputer. Expected metric change if B is chosen: real-PBMC Pearson 0.31 -> 0.39 (expr_decoder) or 0.55 (MVC); synthetic stays ~0.06-0.15.
acceptance: probes/acceptance_checks.py::check_T80_1 - no 'property of the shipped decoder' / 'training-time mask value' text; cell 25 names the synthetic-data cause.

title: DAT9 (MUST): no statement that public PBMC data may overlap scGPT's CELLxGENE pretraining corpus
cells: 0, 25 (cites 'real B, T and monocyte cells from a public PBMC dataset'), BYOD text, Interpretation
evidence_basis: Notebook text has no occurrence of 'overlap' or 'CELLxGENE' (acceptance check). Upstream data/cellxgene/README (cebd6fa): corpus built from CELLxGENE Census version 2023-05-08, normal cells, by organ system including blood. The cited build-time evidence is 10x pbmc3k (MODEL_CARD); whether pbmc3k is in Census 2023-05-08 is not established either way (not checked against the Census listing), and BYOD invites public PBMC/blood data, much of which is in Census.
consequence: The default sample is code-generated, so DAT9 does not bind the default run; it binds the cited public-PBMC separation evidence and any public BYOD dataset. A learner can read high embedding separability on public blood data as transfer when it may be memorisation of pretraining cells.
recommended_correction: Add one sentence near cell 25 and in the BYOD/Interpretation text: scGPT whole-human was pretrained on ~33M normal cells from CELLxGENE Census 2023-05-08 (including blood); overlap with any public PBMC dataset, including the pbmc3k build-time check, cannot be ruled out, so separation on public data may overstate transfer.

title: SEM-ENFORCE: embedding checks and Section 10 adapter parity are recorded but do not gate success
evidence_basis: tools/tutorial_stages.py stage_embed: if FAIL in checks -> print only (no raise), checks written to embed.json; stage_evaluate prints same_as_adapting_process (max_abs_metric_difference == 0.0) without raising. Reload parity in stage_export does raise (line 529). Probe SEM-ENFORCE fail.
consequence: A FAIL in gene-order invariance, batch reproducibility or Section 10 parity still ends in a green run, with the failure only in printed text and state JSON.
recommended_correction: Raise RuntimeError on any FAIL in stage_embed and when Section 10's metric drift is non-zero, with a message naming the check.

title: DAT20: a BYOD refusal prints a stage traceback and ends in a kernel RuntimeError
evidence_basis: tools/tutorial_stages.py main(): 'except BaseException: traceback.print_exc()' for every failure including validation ValueErrors; run_stage streams that traceback and raises RuntimeError('Stage ... failed'). Earlier outputs/ files are not cleared on refusal. Static reading only; refusal path not executed.
consequence: A learner with a malformed BYOD file sees two tracebacks instead of one actionable message, and stale default-path outputs stay on disk.
recommended_correction: In main(), catch ValueError/TypeError from validation, print one message naming file and rule plus the recovery step, exit non-zero without print_exc; clear BYOD-dependent outputs before the data stage.
